description.summary: where a surface's Liquid Glass is

protocol.description: The shell tells atrium the exact shapes of the glass on its surfaces, so the compositor draws the glass (its lens, rim light and shadow) from their geometry rather than guessing it from the surface's pixels.

request.name: get_glass
request.description: A surface has at most one glass object at a time.

interface.name: atrium_glass_v1
interface.description: Double-buffered: shapes set take effect on the surface's next commit, with the buffer they belong to. When the surface is destroyed, this object is inert.

description.summary: no more glass on the surface, from its next commit

request.name: set_shapes
request.description: An array of shapes, each six wl_fixed values: x, y, width, height (surface-local), corner radius, and opacity (0 to 1). An empty array is no glass.

request.name: set_clipped_shapes

description.summary: the glass on the surface, each cut to where it shows

request.description: As set_shapes, with four more wl_fixed values a shape: the box it shows in (x, y, width, height, surface-local), such as the list it was scrolled half out of. The glass is cut there, with no rim along the cut. A width of 0 is the whole shape.
